request: a case for an Apple AirTag (the 2021 one)

body_sources.w: https://developer.apple.com/download/files/accessories/dimensional-drawings/airtag.pdf (p2, AirTag Dimensional Drawings sheet 1, outer ring 'Ø 31.87')
body_sources.h: https://developer.apple.com/download/files/accessories/dimensional-drawings/airtag.pdf (p2, side view, top of dome '7.98' above datum '0.00' at the back plate)
body_sources.profile: https://developer.apple.com/download/files/accessories/dimensional-drawings/airtag.pdf (p2, Detail A 'PROFILE ALL AROUND': the dome's widest point (Ø 31.87) at height 4.98, then inward distance from the edge and height pairs 0.13/5.67, 0.58/6.18, 1.23/6.55, 1.97/6.82, 2.75/7.03, 3.55/7.20, 4.36/7.33, 5.18/7.44, 6.00/7.54, 6.83/7.62, 7.65/7.69, 8.48/7.75, 9.30/7.81, 10.13/7.85, 10.96/7.89, 11.78/7.92, 12.61/7.95, 13.44/7.95, 14.27/7.96, 15.10/7.97, 15.93/7.98 (the center); r = 15.935 - distance. Below 4.98 the dome curves in to the steel back (side view 2.29, 1.89, 1.84, 0.94, 0.88, 0.00, Ø 23.11), drawn not to scale, so the profile keeps the enclosing Ø 31.87 cylinder there)

features.name: speaker_keepout
features.source: https://developer.apple.com/download/files/accessories/dimensional-drawings/airtag.pdf (p2, top view above the side view, third angle projection per title block: note 1 'SPEAKER KEEPOUT. DO NOT OBSTRUCT THIS AREA Ø 25.75', centered; note 1 'CASE SHOULD NOT OBSTRUCT ACOUSTIC AREA')

why: Dome up (+z), steel back plate down: the case wraps the whole tag but must leave Apple's Ø25.75 speaker keepout on the dome open, a round keepout. The body is Apple's own dome profile (Detail A) revolved, so a lip that curls over the dome's edge to hold the tag is measured against the real dome; below the widest point the enclosing cylinder stands in for the unscaled back.
